_meta.product_source: /workspace/game/drink_unlocks.json (14 drinks; products.json from Programmer Master not yet present, ids to match)
_meta.tone: Cozy sitcom. Customers are kind. Off drinks get gentle, funny feedback and the customer still pays.

placeholders.{product}: display name of the ordered product

_meta.note: generic lines use {product}; product_specific lines are only picked when that product is ordered.

legacy_product_ids.iced_lemonade: classic_lemonade (served with extra ice; heat-weather variant)
legacy_product_ids.sweet_coffee: black_coffee + sugar (no longer a menu item; nearest menu drinks: mocha, vanilla_latte)

_meta.gated_rule: product_specific_gated: when an entry for customer+product applies at the current level (min_level/max_level inclusive), pick only from the applicable gated entries; they REPLACE product_specific/generic for that order, never add to them. Rocco strawberry_lemonade: L1-L4 'My mint's still in the mail', L5+ 'The mint finally got delivered'.
_meta.order_rule: Pick product_specific[customer][drink] only if drink unlock_level <= current level. Before a customer's favourite_drink unlocks, they order their slice_order. Wren: black_coffee only until L8.

wren.why: Wren appears at L6 (coffee counter) and orders black coffee until honey_lavender_lemonade unlocks at L8.
